notes: channel 'shopify' items exist on the live store; the bag sends them to the live checkout by variant id.

channel 'cafe' items are on the cafe menu app and the counter board; the full drinks, Palais des Thés, petits plats and salad board was read from the owner's photograph of the in-store menu on 2026-10-22 (41 items); the case items keep their menu-app prices from 2026-10-21. They move into Shopify with the pickup app.
channel 'booking' items are booked by DM or in person today; Sesami or similar takes them in the build (plan section 5.3).
image paths starting with img/ resolve from the demo root; image_cdn keeps the store's original file for re-export.
lead notes quote the store listing or the plan; 'proposed' means the chef has not confirmed it yet.
gf: true marks items the counter board lists as gluten-free (the two salades without their crostini).
